_comment: Blank day plan. Copy this file and name the copy after the date it is for, like 2099-09-14.json. Only files named that way count as plans, so this template can sit here safely. As shipped every field is empty, so Glass shows the clock and the day and leaves the focus area blank. The field by field contract is in the README one folder up.
_comment_date: The date this plan is for, in YYYY-MM-DD form. It should match the file name.
_comment_day_type_override: Normally null. Set it to a day type id from your bell schedule file when today turns out to be a different kind of day than planned, for example "pep_rally". It applies to this date only and leaves your schedule file alone.
_comment_school_wide: The same for every class today. events are short reminders with a when you choose (a weekday, a time, whatever reads well). bobcat_hour_offerings are the tutorials and clubs running during the lunch-and-tutorials block: label fits 30 characters, location fits 12.
_comment_teacher: What is happening in your own room during that block. Leave the label empty when the answer is nothing. label fits 30 characters, location fits 12.
_comment_sections: One entry per block you teach. The key is a block id from your bell schedule file, so Glass picks the right one on its own as the day moves. A block you leave out simply shows an empty focus area, which is normal on a conference period. Copy the shape from _example_section below.

_example_section._comment: Reference only. Nothing in here is read. Copy it into sections above under a real block id. The lengths are what fits on the screen from the back of the room, and anything longer is trimmed rather than wrapped, so it is worth staying inside them.

p1._comment_success_criteria: How a student knows they got there. Up to 40 characters each, two or three of them.
p1._comment_work: Today's work. name fits 34 characters, detail fits 44.
p1._comment_banner: Short reminders that scroll along the bottom for this class.
